description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/G}.
Activate Lluwen by exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, causing Lluwen to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Pest Friend by paying {B/G}, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pest dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
